title: Bulk RNAseq Extraction Protocol
author: Kimberly Paquette
materials: Qiagen RNeasy Lipid Tissue Mini kit
Qubit RNA Broad Range assay kit
Using the Qiagen RNeasy Lipid Tissue Mini kit, prepare reagents and materials for extraction in a chemical hood. Note: use an RNase free environment and clean with RNase Zap.
Follow extraction steps outlined in Qiagen RNeasy Lipid Tissue Mini kit using the Tissue Ruptor II to homogenize frozen brain tissue.

steps.title: Prepare frozen brain tissue
steps.instruction: Manually cut 40–50 mg of frozen brain tissue on dry ice, weigh the pieces, and immediately place them back in a –80 °C freezer; keep the tissue frozen at all times and do not allow it to thaw.

substeps.instruction: Cut 40–50 mg tissue on dry ice

steps.title: Perform on‑column DNase digestion
steps.instruction: Include an on‑column DNase digestion step while keeping the extracted RNA on wet ice.

steps.title: Measure RNA concentration
steps.instruction: Using the Qubit RNA Broad Range assay kit, measure the concentration of extracted RNA by mixing 2 µL of the sample with the assay reagents according to the kit protocol.

steps.title: Aliquot RNA for sequencing
steps.instruction: Aliquot the desired amount of RNA, ensuring that at least 500 ng is obtained for downstream sequencing.

steps.title: Snap‑freeze RNA samples
steps.instruction: Snap‑freeze each RNA aliquot with liquid nitrogen and store the frozen samples at –80 °C indefinitely.

steps.title: Optional Illumina sequencing
steps.instruction: If desired, prepare libraries with Illumina TruSeq stranded ribo‑reduced total RNA kit and sequence to a depth of 50 million reads per sample.
